name: Nightsaber Fang
summary: In Teldrassil, hunters take fangs from the nightsabers prowling the forest. Woodland residents also seek these teeth as reagents.

sections.title: Trophy of the Hunt
sections.body: Nightsabers hunt beneath Teldrassil’s canopy, among the deadliest natural predators of northern Kalimdor. Night elves revere them for their agility, ferocity, and deep spiritual bond with Elune. A hunter who kills one can take its sharp fangs as proof of skill. Some figures in the forest seek those fangs for darker rites.

sections.title: A Satyr's Reagent
sections.body: Outside Dolanaar, the satyr Zenn Foulhoof preys on eager, inexperienced travelers. He claims to need woodland reagents and persuades newcomers to gather nightsaber fangs, strigid feathers, and spider silk. Giving him these materials aids the trickster, who openly mocks the naive hero when they deliver them.

faq.q: Where do Nightsaber Fangs come from?
faq.answer: Nightsaber Fangs come from the predatory nightsabers prowling Teldrassil, especially the forest around Dolanaar.

faq.q: Who wants Nightsaber Fangs in Teldrassil?
faq.answer: Zenn Foulhoof, a satyr outside Dolanaar, asks wandering adventurers to bring him Nightsaber Fangs.

faq.q: Why does Zenn Foulhoof want Nightsaber Fangs?
faq.answer: Zenn claims he needs animal reagents for his work in the forest, but keeps its nature secret and takes delight in duping gullible travelers.

faq.q: What other reagents does Zenn ask for alongside the fangs?
faq.answer: Along with two nightsaber fangs, Zenn asks for two strigid owl feathers and two swatches of webwood spider silk.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know nightsabers as cherished companions and symbols of Elune. Hunting these sacred predators for a treacherous satyr brings shame.
As a hunter, you prove your skill in the wild by felling a nightsaber and taking its fang. Giving its parts to corrupt woodland spirits twists the spirit of the hunt.
